# pact_broker

**Tag**: web, testing, filesystem

## 简介

A server that stores and returns pact files generated by the pact gem. It enables head/prod cross testing of the consumer and provider projects.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/pact-foundation/pact_broker
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/pact_broker/2.121.2
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/pact_broker
